items.title: The OpenAI-Hugging Face hack was enabled by weak sandboxing. It is great that Nvidia is releasing open source tools for
items.summary:
The OpenAI-Hugging Face hack was enabled by weak sandboxing. It is great that Nvidia is releasing open source tools for sandboxing AI agents. OpenWorker, our open-source agent harness supporting cybersecurity workflows, is proud to support this.

A sandbox gives an agent limited permissions. OpenWorker is building on Nvidia OpenShell and will support running each agent's commands inside a sandbox. Only the files relevant to the task go in. Secret API keys, your web browser login credentials, the ability to access arbitrary websites, are inaccessible to the agent by default. These restrictions are implemented in deterministic code rather than by prompting an LLM, which can make mistakes or be susceptible to prompt injections. Further, all actions are logged for monitoring and audit.

I'm grateful for @JensenHuang's leadership making AI agents more secure. OpenWorker (which @rohitcprasad and I are working on) will continue to improve security for agents.

items.title: I replaced Google Keep with Gemini; it's been a game changer for my notes
items.summary:
A Gemini prompt can show you all the sources in your notebook on a particular topic. For example, if you have several notes on a specific topic, you can write a prompt in Gemini to show all sources related to the subject.

If I feel the notebook needs changes, I can edit it with a prompt. I can also delete a notebook without opening Gemini Notebook.

You can still create and edit Keep notes in Gemini, but the notes aren't nearly as powerful as the ones in Gemini Notebook. [...] For example, after creating a notebook, you can generate an AI video on that topic or turn the notes into a podcast that you can listen to on your commute. You can also create quizzes, mind maps, and Slide Decks.

This is possible because Google recently added the @Gemini Notebook connector to Gemini. You can use the Gemini Notebook connector to create, edit, and retrieve information from an existing notebook. [...] For the kind of notes I take, Gemini Notebook has always been a better fit. But before the connector support, it wasn't as easy to get started with the standalone Gemini Notebook web client or app, since you had to do everything manually.

The Gemini Notebook connector in Gemini eliminated that obstacle, and it has been a game changer for my notes.
